payload.title: graphql-scalars 1.25.0 carries GHSA-x8rm-f576-gq67 (high: regular-expression denial of service in the PhoneNumber scalar; every release up to 2.0.0 is affected and no 1.x release is patched); the root-production and root-full legs of the required security-audit job are red on main since the advisory was published on 2026-10-28T21:13Z
evidence: apps/sensor-service/src/vfd/dto/vfd-reading.dto.ts:12 (one of 57 sensor-service files; every import is { GraphQLJSON } from graphql-scalars)
apps/hydroponics-service/src/setup/entities/hydroponics-config.entity.ts:2 (one of 3 hydroponics-service files; same single import; nothing in the repository imports PhoneNumber)

.github/workflows/ci-affected.yml:security-audit (run 40721325914 on main 645c5313 at 2026-10-28T16:05Z: every leg clean; PR #2188 run 40947682648 at 2026-10-29T20:30Z: root-production and root-full red on GHSA-x8rm-f576-gq67)
payload.rule_violated: npm-audit gate (scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs): an advisory with a patched release is fixed, not excepted
payload.notes: External drift. The platform uses only GraphQLJSON. 2.0.0 drops graphql-js <16 and Node.js 20; the root graph resolves graphql 16.14.2 and every backend image runs Node 22. The published 1.25.0 and 2.0.1 CommonJS trees differ only in error.js and scalars/PhoneNumber.js; scalars/json and its typings are byte-identical, and the package layout and exports map are unchanged. Fix: the root dependency ^2.0.1, a dependency-security floor and the lock move to 2.0.1.
